account.title: Account
account.description:
Account identifier of the Snowflake instance. This is a prefix of your Snowflake instance URL, e.g. keboola.eu-central-1.
See the documentation for more information.

username.title: Username
username.description: Snowflake user, which will be used to run queries.

#password.title: Password
#password.description: A password authenticating the Snowflake user. Provide either a Password or a Private Key below. Snowflake is phasing out password authentication for service accounts, so key-pair authentication is recommended for automated jobs.

#private_key.title: Private Key
#private_key.description: PEM-formatted RSA private key (PKCS#8) for Snowflake key-pair (JWT) authentication. Provide this instead of a Password. The matching public key must be assigned to the user with ALTER USER ... SET RSA_PUBLIC_KEY. See the key-pair authentication documentation.

#private_key_pass.title: Private Key Passphrase
#private_key_pass.description: Optional passphrase if the private key above is encrypted. Leave empty for an unencrypted key.

warehouse.title: Warehouse
warehouse.description: Name of the Snowflake warehouse to be used.
